title: Author the app build-type template
description: Create templates/app/template.json and templates/app/files/: package.json (name {{slug}}, start script 'node src/server.js', test script), README.md, .gitignore, src/server.js exporting a request handler and a start(port) helper using node:http, test/server.test.js that binds an ephemeral port (listen(0)), makes one request and asserts the response. Only {{slug}}/{{summary}} placeholders; only node: built-ins. A test renders the template and asserts required_files + valid report.
acceptance_criteria: templates/app/template.json validates against template.schema.json and lists its required_files.
Scaffolding build_type=app renders the files/ tree with placeholders substituted and writes a valid scaffold-report.json.
The rendered server test binds an ephemeral port and passes under node --test with zero dependencies; full suite passes.
